resources.string: Choose inputs before starting. System audio and microphone use separate recognition sessions and captions. Both inputs may incur separate service charges. Stop before changing inputs.
Allow microphone access to translate your speech.
Microphone audio is sent to your selected recognition service while translation is running. Use headphones when also capturing system audio to avoid picking up speaker playback twice.
No microphone speech detected. Check the microphone and speak nearby.
Microphone ready. Speak to see captions.
System audio and microphone are captured separately.
Starting sends the selected audio input (%1$s) to your recognition service.
Allow overlays and microphone access. Screen sharing is not needed for microphone-only translation.
Play speech and speak into the microphone
Starting connects to %1$s and may incur service charges. Speak a few words after starting.

Off by default. Enable before starting to save confirmed source text and translations privately on this device, within storage limits. Stop to view or export the saved session. Turning this off clears captions saved during the current session; previous sessions remain until you delete them. Audio is not recorded.

Sessions appear here after translation stops. View captions a page at a time or export source text and translations as TXT or Markdown. Exports include input labels and timestamps. Delete sessions explicitly to remove their private local files.
No saved captions yet. Enable Save captions before starting a session.
Delete this saved session from this device? This cannot be undone.
Saved sessions could not be read. Check available storage and retry.
Could not save this setting. Retry before starting.
Some captions could not be saved. Stop, check free space, then start a new session.
Storage limit reached. Earlier saved captions remain available.
Could not delete the session. Please retry.
Could not export captions. Check the destination and retry.
One input has no audio. Check system playback and the microphone.
